settings.language.title: Settings: label of the Language picker.
settings.language.system: Settings > Language: the first option, follow the device's language.
codeblock.copy: Chat code block header row, and the full screen code view's top bar: accessibility label and tooltip of the copy icon button (verb, command: copy the code).
codeblock.copied: Chat and full screen views: label a copy icon button takes for 1.5 s after copying, shown as a checkmark (status, past participle: the text was copied).
codeblock.expand: Chat code block header row: accessibility label and tooltip of the expand icon button that opens the code full screen (verb, command).
codeblock.wrap: Full screen code view, top bar: accessibility label and tooltip of a toggle icon; on, long lines wrap; off, they scroll sideways (verb phrase, command).
codeblock.untitled: Chat code block header row, shown in place of the language name when the code names none; also the full screen code view's name for screen readers (noun: program code).
table.copy: Full screen table view, top bar: accessibility label and tooltip of the copy icon button (verb, command: copy the table as Markdown text).
table.expand: Chat, above a table wider than the message: accessibility label and tooltip of the expand icon button that opens the table full screen (verb, command).
table.fullscreen_title: Full screen table view: its name for screen readers (noun: a data table).
fullscreen.close: Full screen code or table view, top bar: accessibility label and tooltip of the close icon button (verb, command).
host_down.title: Host-down panel title. {host} is the Host computer's name, never translated.
host_down.since: When the Host stopped answering. {time} is a clock time like 09:14 or the "yesterday {time}" string.
host_down.yesterday: Inside "Since {time}" and the list row, lower case: yesterday plus a 24-hour clock time.
host_down.trying_in_s: Quiet status line: seconds until the app asks the Host again. "s" is the unit abbreviation.
host_down.trying_in_min: Quiet status line: minutes until the app asks the Host again.
host_down.back_online: Shown for two seconds when the Host answers again.
host_down.read_only: Message field placeholder while the Host does not answer; saved messages stay readable.
host_down.row: Chat list row for a Host that does not answer. {time} as in host_down.since; lower-case "since".
host_down.device_offline: Banner when this phone or computer has no network at all.
host_down.check_tailscale: Button; Tailscale is a product name, never translated.
host_down.pair_again: Button: sign this device in to the Host again with a new token.
host_down.switch_host: Button: open another of the user's Hosts.
host_down.copy_diagnostics: Button: copy a short technical text for support.
host_down.token_or_link: Placeholder of the token field. "?token=" is literal, never translated.
host_down.token_needed: Error under the token field. "clarp-admin url" is a command, never translated.
host_down.reason.server_stopped: Clarp is the product name, never translated.
